name: pixart-sigma-1024-torchtrt
description: PixArt-Sigma XL-2 via torch-trt (T5EncoderWrapper + PixArtDiTWrapper + VAEDecoderWrapper). Per-component cosine similarity against HF + end-to-end image generation sanity.
prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
notes: Torch-TRT PixArt-Sigma: torch_tensorrt compiled engines with engine-declared tensor precision. Per-component stages compare individual engines (T5, DiT, VAE) via cosine similarity against HF. End-to-end uses DPM-Solver++ and gates image variance against the HF reference, so blank or garbage images fail even when PSNR/SSIM are weak.
